sourceFile: 3. BRS-161016 Report test process CM press change from machine semi AM to K3 6AXIS AM Date 2025.2.20_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies the report but misstates the baseline/test change and has parsing errors needing correction.
issues: Changed factor should be SEMI AM baseline vs K3 6AXIS AM test, not unclear baseline with both as changed.
Change domain is overbroad; evidence supports equipment/process change, not supplier/material.
Tension test condition/spec parsing is corrupted, especially K3 row values in the condition field.
Purpose/content evidence rows omit the clearest row 6 in the main evidence list.
Judgements remain not_judged despite apparent pass-style results and decision section not captured.
correctionPlan: Set baselineCondition to SEMI AM and changedCondition to K3 6AXIS AM.
Limit changeDomain to equipment and process condition.
Reparse tension rows 33-34 into condition, spec, samples, min, max, average, and result fields.
Add row 6 and relevant result/decision rows as evidence citations.
Verify final decision row 41+ and update outcome judgements if supported.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are not sufficient until corrected grouping and parsed result rows are cited.
